pz.lightDarkHint: Light or dark mode. Auto follows your device's setting
pz.accentGlass: Follows the wallpaper unless you pick a color
pz.accentFui: Recolors the neon glow, highlights and switches
pz.displayHint: Brightness of NoCapOS on this screen
pz.brightnessHint: Dims NoCapOS on this screen — also in the Control Center
pz.iconsHint: How NoCapOS's own apps look in the Dock, Launchpad, on the desktop and in Settings. Installed apps keep their own icons.
pz.gridHint: A faint holographic grid behind the desktop
pz.transparencyHint: How see-through windows, the dock, widgets and menus are. Lower is crisper and faster; 0% is fully solid.
pz.motionHint: Turn off animations, scan sweeps and click pulses
pz.wallpapersHint: Built-in wallpapers and pictures you added. Delete your own with the trash icon.
pz.cyberWall: Cyber-Deck shows its own backdrop. Your own pictures still work; switch to Glass or NoCap classic for these wallpapers.
pz.deletePhotoMsg: It is removed from this browser. If it is showing now, the default wallpaper takes its place.
pz.tooLarge: That image is too large to save. Try a smaller one.
pz.badImage: That image couldn't be used. Try another one.
pz.dimHint: Makes icons and widgets easier to read on bright photos
pz.layoutHint: Where the Dock sits and how big it is
pz.behaviorHint: Hiding, recent apps and open-app dots
pz.autoHideHint: Move the pointer to the screen edge to show it — windows get the whole screen
pz.recentsHint: Up to three recently used apps after a divider
pz.dotsHint: A dot under each app that has a window open
pz.dockTip: Tip: drag icons to reorder the Dock, or right-click the Dock to reset it.
pz.widgetsHint: Small live panels on the desktop
pz.showWidgetsHint: Right-click the desktop and choose Edit widgets to add, move or resize them
pz.desktopIconsHint: Size, names and grid of icons on the desktop
pz.snapHint: Dropped icons line up on the grid
pz.cleanUpHint: Line up every desktop icon on the grid
pz.titleBarHint: Window buttons and what double-clicking a title bar does
pz.winTip: Tip: right-click a title bar or an app icon for New window; drag a window to a screen edge to snap it.
pz.resetSectionHint: Put the look and feel back to defaults
pz.resetHint: Theme, colors, wallpaper, Dock, desktop and window settings go back to defaults
